property_summary: After any call to transfer where _tos is non-empty, the correct contract always makes exactly _tos.length external calls to caddress, while the buggy contract makes zero external calls; this difference is observable by deploying a reverting token that makes transfer revert, so the correct contract reverts and the buggy one returns true.
change_summary: Remove the entire for loop, so no external calls are made, but still return true.
